headline: Dead Lands Clashes Deepen as Stonecradle Erupts in Sudden Attrition
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, the central and western fronts have seen sharp escalation, led by four fresh base actions in the Dead Lands and an explosive surge of combat across Stonecradle. The Dead Lands remains the war's sharpest flashpoint, recording continuous fighting around Callahan's Boot with over sixteen hundred combined casualties in the past two hours alone. In Stonecradle, engagements around The Long Fast detonated into heavy fighting, generating more than eighteen hundred casualties in two hours alongside rapidly accelerating deployment rates. Marban Hollow also flared into activity with two recent base transitions leaving Mox contested as no-man's-land. Meanwhile, base turnover paused in Stlican Shelf and King's Cage following flurries earlier in the shift, though Stlican Shelf still absorbed over a thousand casualties in the latest two-hour interval. Sustained infantry grinding continues unabated in Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse without immediate territorial changes, while Callahan's Passage recorded a sudden spike in enlistments and skirmishing in the final hour.
